setup: if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.claude/settings.local.json" ]; then mkdir -p .claude && cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.claude/settings.local.json" .claude/settings.local.json && chmod 600 .claude/settings.local.json; else echo 'paseo setup: no .claude/settings.local.json in source checkout, skipping'; fi

if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env.local" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local && chmod 600 .env.local; else echo 'paseo setup: no .env.local in source checkout, skipping'; fi
if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/secrets.json" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/secrets.json" secrets.json && chmod 600 secrets.json; fi
